description: Scan a public domain and return the full scan record: score and its two parts, level, per-check status, evidence, and fingerprint. A stored record younger than 6 hours is returned without a new scan, unless fresh is true. New scans are limited to 10 per client per minute and 3 running at once. A new scan runs for up to 60 s. If the call times out first, the scan still finishes and is stored, and a later call returns it.

fresh.description: Scan again instead of returning a stored record younger than 6 hours (default false).

target.description: Domain or URL to scan, for example "example.com".

name: scan_site
title: Scan a site
